name: Vietnam commercial-cover and software-development historical network

attribution.legal_posture: This is a historical source-attributed research finding with historical status; current sanctions, criminal adjudication, and verified civil identity require separate sources.

organizations: Phan Minh FMC-V.N. Trading Co., Ltd.
Truong Phu Group Joint Stock Company
caveats: The reporting is historical; present activity, current account control, and knowing participation by every named foreign entity require newer or source-specific evidence.
The baseline and deep historical packages contain only the listed relationship context; a Vietnam company, restaurant, or kjg197318 relationship is absent.
Publish the organization-level historical relationship. Omit registry signatures, addresses, personal contact details, and images.
The entity and account relationships are presented as C4ADS findings based on public registry documents, shared addresses, web records, and repeated portfolio artifacts.

statements: C4ADS linked DPRK restaurants in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City to locally registered Vietnamese companies through shared addresses, public registry records, website registration, and public-facing identifiers.
The report then connected Truong Phu Group's listed representative name to a software-development account using the same kjg197318 identifier seen across multiple freelancing platforms.
This case illustrates a local-company and non-IT commercial-cover layer around an overseas software team rather than a simple stand-alone remote-worker account.
limitations: Publish the organization-level historical relationship. Omit registry signatures, addresses, personal contact details, and images.
Named foreign partners or clients must not be described as knowing participants unless the cited source explicitly says so.
